summary: Full backend regression for Cloud Inventory Management System against the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 25/25 pytest tests passed covering health, product CRUD (incl. SKU uniqueness 409, 404, validation), sales (stock decrement, insufficient stock 400, invalid product 404, quantity validation), insights (low-stock, per-product with divide-by-zero handling, 404), AI summary endpoints (mock provider), cascade delete, and /api prefix enforcement.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_service.get_ai_provider() silently falls back to MockAIProvider for any non-mock AI_PROVIDER value. Consider raising/logging a warning when an unknown provider is configured so misconfiguration is visible.

compute_low_stock_insights iterates products and awaits compute_product_insight one-by-one — fine for ~8 products, but for larger datasets an aggregated SUM(quantity) GROUP BY product_id query over the last 7 days would avoid N+1 DB round-trips.
server.py lifespan runs create_all + seed_if_empty on every startup. Acceptable for a 1-week project, but for prod a proper migration tool (Alembic) is recommended.
CORS is set to allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for credentialed requests. Not a blocker here (no auth) but worth tightening later.
list_sales hardcodes a .limit(500) with no pagination metadata — consumers cannot page past 500 sales.
seed_data_creation: Did not create seed data. Used the app's own startup seed (8 demo products + 7-day random sales). Test-created products are prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up via fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 25 backend tests pass against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Reusable regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_inventory_backend.py and can be re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_inventory_backend.py -v. The AI provider is intentionally mocked (MockAIProvider, AI_PROVIDER=mock in backend/.env) per the user's product requirement. Frontend was NOT tested in this iteration.
